Search and collect hidden stars scattered across detailed Easter-themed scenes, employing keen observation to uncover each secret item. The game challenges players to carefully scan colorful holiday backgrounds while progressing through increasingly intricate levels filled with subtle visual cues. Timing and attention improve as puzzles grow more complex, making each stage a rewarding discovery experience.

Key Features

• Hidden star spotting mechanic  
• Mouse-driven selection control  
• Level-based star collection goals  
• Progressive puzzle difficulty scaling  
• Easter holiday visual design

pages.title: Easter Cookies
pages.creator: GAMEGOS
pages.description:
Drag and decorate colorful cookie shapes using simple drag-and-drop mechanics in this festive baking challenge. Players combine icing and toppings to complete Easter-themed treats while managing time limits and crafting combos to increase scores. Progression unlocks new cookie types and decorative tools, adding variety and depth to the time-management gameplay loop.

Key Features

• Drag-and-drop cookie decoration  
• Timer-based scoring challenges  
• Combo-based scoring system  
• Unlockable cookie varieties  
• Easter-themed baking aesthetics
